lines: - "How did we just lose a significant percentage of our bioplasma reserves? Well? Hello? Any techs care to run a diagnostic?"
- "That's no system fault. We've got an intruder. Triple robotics security on all vaults!"

- "There. Camera five. What is that thing? Tenno? No.... doesn't fight like a Tenno. Troops: Monitor. But keep your distance. Am I on? Intruder! This is Captain Xeto of The Ardent, in service to Mighty Parvos. Whoever you are, stand down. Your actions will not be tolerated!"
- "Well done, whatever you are. It seems you have what you came for. But why?"
- "He's a what? Read me that entry, ensign. But what use would the Tenno-hunter have for medical-grade bioplasma? Track him."
- "A failed breach? What is going on? Is anyone on this ship capable of giving me a straight answer?"
- "He's on a derelict. One of the old Corpus hulks off Eris. Find me the cargo manifest. I want to know what he's searching for."
- "He's woken a Juggernaut! Clumsy. Unless he meant to? But... why?"
- "Wait. Bioplasma... now Cortichrome... Could it be he's playing doctor? "
- "There's a Warframe at the bottom of all this, I'm sure of it. Alert the Sisterhood. No - alert Vala herself. I want to deliver this asset to her personally."
- "He's coming up! Get security in position. Do not screw this up for me. The Sisterhood doesn't give second chances."
- "He took something. Rip it from his dead hands."
- "All crews cease fire, cease fire! Stop firing!"
